config.notes: Toi Ohomai course pages (www.toiohomai.ac.nz/study/course/<slug>) are stored in the default NZ/Australian (domestic) view: they carry only domestic indicative fees, so no fee is read. Start dates are printed per campus under 'Course Locations and Intake Information' as 'Location Campus Start Date Rotorua Mokoia Campus 22 Feb 2027 Apply now ...' (dates are explicit, so no term mapping is needed). IELTS overall is the first IELTS figure within 200 characters after 'English Language Requirements' (wordings: 'IELTS Academic score of 6 with no band score lower than 5.5', 'Level 5 certificate or diploma IELTS Academic score of 5.5', 'an IELTS (general or academic) score of 5.5', 'IELTS 5.0'). Campus is read from the intake table. Duration and delivery mode are not printed in the stored text. Central key dates: https://www.toiohomai.ac.nz/study/important-dates (2027: Semester 1 starts 22 Feb, Semester 2 starts 19 Jul). Central English guidance: https://www.toiohomai.ac.nz/study/get-help-english (refers to NZQA rules; per-course figures are on each course page).
